content.title: Muslims Day Ansar Update!
content.subtitle: 559 people have already joined as Ansars!
content.body:
🌿 Alhamdulillah! Muslims Day Ansars are now 559.

Today is Jumu'ah. A day when du'as are accepted. A day to invest something for your Akhirah.

Just two months ago, we started the Muslims Day Ansar (Supporter) initiative. Alhamdulillah, already 559 brothers and sisters have become part of this da'wah mission.

May Allah Ta'ala grant all of them the best reward in this world and the Hereafter. Ameen.

🎯 What is the mission of Muslims Day?

The goal of Muslims Day is not just to operate an app.

Our dream is to build a platform that will help millions of Muslims come closer to Allah every day. It will help them read the Qur'an, become more mindful of Salah, learn du'as, and guide their families toward Islam.

In the next 6 months, we want to increase the Muslims Day app installations to 10 million, Insha'Allah.

So that more people can have the opportunity to gain authentic Islamic knowledge, perform good deeds, and purify themselves.

🤝 Who are Muslims Day Ansars?

To carry out this mission, regular financial support is needed.

Therefore, among millions of users, we are looking for only 2,000 Ansars who will contribute 500 BDT per month to take part in this Sadaqah Jariyah.

They are not just premium subscribers, but companions in this da'wah mission.

📊 Our next goal

To complete the caravan of 2,000 Ansars, we still need 1,441 more supporters.

Your participation is also very important in this journey of delivering beneficial Islamic knowledge to 10 million Muslims.

Perhaps Allah Ta'ala will make you a means of bringing the light of Deen to countless more people.

💎 What are the benefits of becoming an Ansar?

✅ Opportunity to share in the reward of the good deeds of millions of people

✅ 7 premium subscriptions of Muslims Day

✅ 1 premium subscription of the Mahfil app

✅ FREE participation in special online halaqahs, seminars, and exclusive events

But the greatest benefit is becoming part of an ongoing service to the Deen.

🌙 A decision on this Jumu'ah

Perhaps 500 BDT per month is not a very large amount for you. Maybe it is the cost of having breakfast at a restaurant just once!

But this small contribution could become a Sadaqah Jariyah whose reward will continue even after your death, Insha'Allah.

.

On this blessed day of Jumu'ah, you too can join as a Muslims Day Ansar.

Insha'Allah, this may become one of the most beautiful investments for your Akhirah.

.

I also want to become a Muslims Day Ansar! 👉 Click 👉 https://id.kahf.co/ansar/muslimsday
